definitions.explanation: A person who owns a house or apartment building and rents it out to tenants.
The person who owns and lives in a house (less common usage).

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay rent to the landlord.

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't renovate without the landlord's permission.

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}⟦さん→さん：09848_san⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧⟦{助|たす}かった→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: I was grateful that the landlord was a very kind person.

examples.japanese: {家主|やぬし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To protect the house as the head of household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{家主|やぬし}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather was the head of this household for many years.
While the homeowner was away, the neighbor kept an eye on the house.

notes:
{家主|やぬし} refers to the owner of a property, primarily used in the context of renting. It covers both a landlord who rents out property and (less commonly) the head of a household.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {家主|やぬし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (contact the landlord)
- {家主|やぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (the landlord's permission)
- {家主|やぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{借主|かりぬし}→借主：noentry⟧ (landlord and tenant)
- {家主|やぬし}⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧ (landlord's responsibility)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧: landlord (more colloquial, especially for apartment buildings; very common in daily speech)
- ⟦{地主|じぬし}→地主：12048_jinushi⟧: landowner (owns land, not necessarily buildings)
- ⟦{借主|かりぬし}→借主：noentry⟧: tenant, renter (the opposite party)
- ⟦{貸主|かしぬし}→貸主：noentry⟧: lender, lessor (formal/legal term for the renting-out party)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. ⟦{大家|おおや}→大家：01907_ooya⟧ is more commonly used in everyday conversation when referring to apartment landlords.
